criteria.outcome: Each strategy passage map is the sole semantic owner of normalized matrix obligations, exact passage candidates, and optional exact fragment-review allocations; copied matrix prose, inferred mappings, authored duplicate status, aliases, and relation-to-relation endpoints fail.

The current comparison matrix deterministically yields one exact obligation for every applicable matrix relation, field, claim, and prior-art document, including every member of a multi-document relationship and every claim named in a dependent-claim range.

Every computed matrix obligation has exactly one authored current state: passage-mapped, counsel-review-required, or reviewed-no-material-passage; no-material is permitted only for an exact matrix dash field and absence of a candidate never becomes an absence conclusion.

One exact unit or unique phrase may own zero, one, or many candidates; each candidate closes exact mapped obligations and ordered digest-bound non-root XML passages, while duplicate identity is canonical over its evidence endpoints and cannot be evaded by proposition or endpoint-order changes.

Candidate validation precedes coverage: the accepted candidate set names every passage-mapped obligation and no other state, distinct candidates may share an obligation, and a rejected candidate or one mapped document supplies no residual or cross-document coverage.

A fragment-review allocation has one exact claim-unit subject, sorted exact counsel-review-required obligation identities for the same claim, no evidence endpoint, no status field, one neutral relevance note, and a unique semantic signature; ancestry, similarity, and defaults never create an allocation.

A claim-root preamble never acts as a multi-limitation or whole-claim roll-up: combination, multi-document, and multi-obligation preamble candidates fail; dependent ancestry creates neither a child candidate nor an allocation, and exact phrase selectors remain unique contiguous text.

Each prior-art consumer receives the claim XML, both relation XML owners, and every transcription XML package in matrix scope; scope additions become operative only through their declared XML handoff with no allowlist, inferred edge, or fallback reader.

Exactly the current claim-prior-art passage-map profile is accepted; non-current profiles, unsupported fields or record kinds, migration readers, compatibility aliases, and dual-format parsing fail before any product write.

The semantic contract pair, data registry, exclusive profile, current relation XML, generated Markdown, model enforcement, tests, handoffs, products, and live-path census form one retained state; missing, weaker, duplicate, alternate, stale, compatibility, copied-selection, or orphaned state fails.
